scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:infra: pnpm build:packages && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/shared-services -p "test_*.py" && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/monitoring -p "test_*.py" && node --test scripts/shared-services/config.test.mjs && pnpm perf:test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:infra && pnpm --filter @havefolio/enrichment test && pnpm --filter @havefolio/logging test && pnpm --filter @havefolio/contracts test && pnpm --filter @havefolio/domain test && pnpm --filter @havefolio/db test && pnpm --filter @havefolio/test-utils test && pnpm --filter @havefolio/api test:unit && pnpm --filter @havefolio/worker test:unit && pnpm --filter @havefolio/monitoring test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @havefolio/api test:integration && pnpm --filter @havefolio/worker test:integration
